newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Security Bank sets rights offer date.
newsitem.headline: Security Bank sets rights offer date.

text.p: Security Bank Corp said on Wednesday the record date for its stock rights offering has been set at October 31, 1996.
The bank had approved a stock rights offer of one share for every two and a half shares held. The offer price is at 25 pesos per share, the bank said in a notice to brokers.

Proceeds of the offering estimated at 1.6 billion pesos will be used for investment in new subsidiaries, automation projects, transfer to a new head office building, branch expansion and reinvestments.
